CC0-1.0, version 1.0, exact file identity, STILT endpoint coordinate meanings.
ATTO eddy covariance measured at 81 m; filtered half-hourly fluxes used for NEE, gap-filling, and partitioning; full processing details referred to Supporting Information Text S5.

metadata_evidence.supports: Monthly totals of NEE, GPP, Reco and monthly mean regional deltaCO2 are supplied by dataset DOI.

limitations: Monthly derived flux totals only; underlying half-hourly observations and quality flags are absent from this file.
The pilot does not reproduce original filtering, gap-filling, or partitioning.
No geographic footprint is assigned to the table. finalLat/finalLon are trajectory endpoints and must not be interpreted as fixed tower coordinates.
Original source series lacks May 2021; the selected 2023 year is complete.
Supporting Information Text S5 was not separately reviewed in this pilot inspection.
doi_scope: The dataset DOI identifies the original deposited package. This preparation has no separately registered DOI.
processing: Retain Time, Year, Month and the three monthly carbon-flux columns.
Preserve original numeric strings; no new flux calculation or spatial inference.
pilot_corrections: Existing matches.csv calls the date column TimeYearMonth, but the source header is Time with separate Year and Month columns.
Existing matching evidence labels finalLat/finalLon station coordinates; authoritative dataset description says mean STILT ending locations.
source_column_correction: The date column is Time, not TimeYearMonth. finalLat/finalLon are STILT trajectory endpoints, not station coordinates.
source_time_gap_note: The original monthly series lacks May 2021; the selected 2023 year is complete.

Time.description: Month-end label for the monthly aggregation, retained from the source table; not an instantaneous sample time.

NEE_gCper_m2_month.description: Monthly net ecosystem exchange. Selected values satisfy NEE = Reco - GPP; negative values indicate net uptake.

GPP_gCper_m2_month.description: Monthly gross primary productivity from partitioned eddy-covariance fluxes.

Reco_gCper_m2_month.description: Monthly ecosystem respiration from partitioned eddy-covariance fluxes.

original: Unnamed row index, 0 through 118; not a scientific variable.
original.finalLat: Mean ending latitude of STILT backward trajectories, not ATTO station latitude.
original.finalLon: Mean ending longitude of STILT backward trajectories, not ATTO station longitude.
original.deltaCO2_ppm: Monthly averaged regional CO2 signal, parts per million.
